system: Chronicles of Swarajya: World Map & Regions Registry

sahyadri_gateway_valley.name: Sahyadri Gateway Valley (Connected Open World)
sahyadri_gateway_valley.biome: Monsoon Teak Forest, River Crossing, Hill Pass & Kot Fortress

subZones.name: Sacred Awakening Forest
subZones.description: Lush teak groves where Shivaji awakens and gathers his initial timber and ironstone ore.

subZones.name: Koyna Stream & Timber Footbridge
subZones.description: Flowing river separating the deep woods from the settled village and mountain paths.

subZones.name: Bhavani Nagar Settlement
subZones.description: Rustic village with thatched huts, an ancient central stone well, blacksmith forge, and elder's home.

subZones.name: Deshmukh Raider Encampment
subZones.description: Hostile forward encampment with military pavilion tents, supply caches, and enemy sentries threatening the valley.

subZones.name: Kot Fort Monumental Approach & Citadel
subZones.description: Steep stone staircase, twin monumental bastions, iron-spiked timber gate, and courtyard bastion.
